title: Use Seedance 2 with JSON prompts to structure your generation instructions.
content:
Use Seedance 2 with JSON prompts to structure your generation instructions.
Control Seedance 2 frame by frame by specifying per-frame instructions in the JSON prompt.
Use Omni mode on mitte_ai to generate a 15-second advertising film with Seedance 2.
